title: Museum front of house with a late opening

unsupported.quote: Lucy is still in her first month, so she can only work on days when Ben is in as well.
unsupported.reason: The catalog's together rule pairs two people on the same shift; no rule ties the days one person works to the days another person works.

notes: Development scenario (ADR-0008 D1), never part of a gate. Written by the reviewer for TASK-005e6. The weekday desk, gallery and evening shifts overlap, so the no-overlap rule binds; the evening shifts end at 21:30, less than twelve hours before the next morning. The reference plan has hard 0 and soft 0 (no plan can beat it) and also honours the mandatory request about Lucy: every day she works, Ben works too.
